title: Redbrand Hideout · Area 7 · Storeroom

sourceRecords.title: 13 · Armory and storeroom · areas 6–7
read: Weapon racks line one chamber; the next smells of leather, fur, and dust. Old storage here still serves someone.

The arrangement of the stored equipment makes it possible to examine one part of the room without disturbing everything else. You can check what is within reach, look for markings, or study the exits. Anything useful still has to be inspected before you decide to carry it away.

brief: North end of a natural cavern finished with dressed stone walls and flagstone flooring. Stored barrels, EMPTY crates, packing straw, hammers, pry bars and nails; bundled beaver pelts among mundane goods. Wide natural cavern continues south, giving a distant view toward an ordinary dark crevasse. No visible secret doors, gold hoard, nothic or prisoners. Functional work/storage space, not a sealed box chamber.
